next_training_recommendation.experiment: Compare the current pooled-slot Joker-sale head against a residual score conditioned on each Joker token and the global state. Initialize the added output to zero so initial policy probabilities match, and record the architecture variant explicitly in checkpoint metadata.
next_training_recommendation.controls: Use pinned current-rule records, unchanged v13 observations, two matched training seeds, identical data ordering, objectives, optimizer settings, and update counts. Keep the rest of the policy trainable under the same settings in both arms.
next_training_recommendation.measurements: Track conditional Joker-selection probability and sale decisions on all visited states, including excess sales when the teacher would choose another action. Evaluate sampled end-to-end games as the primary outcome; teacher-hand-assisted games can diagnose the shop contribution. Reserve new confirmation seeds because this study's panels are exposed.
